verdict.rationale: YYLO is a coding-agent orchestrator, so automatic model routing is a fair axis, but the evidence shows only explicit, user-specified agent and model choice: a `--subagent claude` flag, model selectors bound before benchmark execution, and generic delegation across agents and models. Nothing documents automatically routing each task prompt to the most suitable model, and the design emphasis is on explicit operator choices.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have each task prompt automatically routed to the most suitable underlying model
